faq: Do I need to supply a new design?
No. We can design and build in one go, starting from your logo and brand colors. If you already have a Figma design, send it and we build that instead, which often keeps the price at the lower end.
Will the redesign hurt my search rankings?

We aim to protect them. Page addresses stay the same unless there is a reason to change them, titles and headings are kept, and any moved page gets a 301 redirect. We cannot promise rankings, but we avoid the common mistakes.
Do you redesign the live site directly?
We work on a copy of the project, show you a preview and publish only after your approval. Your live site keeps running as normal while we build.
Is new copy and photography included?
We reuse your existing text and images and reshape them to fit the new layout. If you want fresh copy or photos, send them in and we place them, or we flag the gaps in the handover.

desc:
A Webflow redesign that keeps your rankings gives a live site a current look and faster pages without discarding the content and addresses that already bring visitors. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds the design in your project and keeps titles and URLs in place.

## What is a Webflow redesign?

A Webflow redesign is a visual and structural refresh of a site that already exists in Webflow. Fonts, colors, spacing, layouts, navigation and sections are reworked, while the pages, words and web addresses that carry value stay put. It differs from a rebuild, which starts over, and from a migration, which moves a site between platforms.

The aim is a site that looks like the business it represents today, loads quickly and is easier to edit.

## Why an outdated design costs you attention

Visitors form an opinion of a company from its site within moments. Dated typography, cramped sections, inconsistent buttons and layouts that fall apart on a phone all suggest a business that has not kept up. That impression affects whether people enquire, buy or even keep reading.

Years of small edits cause drift. Different heading sizes, colors that nearly match and duplicated classes pile up inside the project. A redesign is also a chance to clean that structure, which makes every later edit quicker.

## How a redesign affects results without hurting search

Search engines care about the address, the content and the signals around a page. Changing the look should not require changing any of those. By keeping URLs, headings, page titles and meta descriptions in place, a redesign preserves what search engines already know about your pages. Where an address must change, we add a redirect.

Speed is part of the gain. Cleaner structure, resized images and lighter sections help pages load faster, and faster pages are easier on visitors on phones and slower connections. No one can promise search results after any change, but this approach avoids the common mistakes.

## What a strong redesign includes

- A short review of what already works and should be kept.
- A new visual direction: fonts, colors, buttons and spacing.
- Updated navigation and footer that match the new style.
- Redesigned key pages, with CMS template pages restyled.
- A style guide inside the project so future pages stay consistent.
- Images resized and layouts simplified for speed.
- Responsive layouts checked on desktop, tablet and phone.
- Optional scroll and hover motion used with restraint.
- Existing URLs, titles and meta descriptions kept in place.
- A redirect check and launch support.

## How we carry it out

We start by reviewing your current pages with you, deciding what stays and what changes. For larger packages, you see a design preview before we build, so direction is agreed early. The rebuild happens in a duplicate of your project, and nothing changes on the live site until you approve.

The Basic package refreshes your home page and one inner page with a new look and an updated menu and footer. The Standard package redesigns several main pages, with a style guide, image cleanup, restyled CMS templates and a design preview. The Premium package covers a wider set of pages with new custom sections, motion, speed checks, redirect review and launch support, followed by a period of fixes. An extra page, a logo and favicon pack and a blog template redesign are available as add-ons.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send examples of sites and styles you like.
- Decide which pages are essential before we start.
- Provide logo files and approved brand colors.
- Review the preview and give feedback in one round.
- Keep your existing page addresses unless there is a clear reason to change them.

**Avoid:**
- Rewriting every page of copy during the design phase.
- Changing page addresses without redirects.
- Adding motion to every element.
- Choosing fonts that slow loading.
- Approving a design only on a desktop screen.

## Who this service is for

This service suits established businesses whose site no longer matches their brand, owners who have outgrown the template they started with, and teams preparing for a campaign or investor meeting who need a sharper first impression. It is not aimed at moving from another platform, which is a separate service.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, logo and brand assets, favorite examples and any pages that must not change. New copy and photography are not part of the package, so let us know if you have your own. We never need your password. We work as a collaborator in your own Webflow project.
